source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons
source_window.data_date: 2026-10-06 (Historic England listed-building data download page update date)

first_missing_criterion: Official Historic England NHLE Listed Building polygon feature payload for ListEntry 1420669 (Exeter City War Memorial), with returned Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates and bound ListEntry/Name/Grade fields. The official Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer and exposes ListEntry, Name and Grade fields, but the distinct exact-record GeoJSON query could not be retrieved through the available web channel and direct network resolution failed; therefore no record-level geometry was read and no individual building record was accepted.
